name: fr-security-review
description: Framework-aware static-first security audit for PHP/Symfony/Laravel: recipe-driven recon, focused worker waves, deterministic deduplication. Schema v2.

interface.shortDescription: Static-first security audit for PHP / Symfony / Laravel.
interface.longDescription: A framework-aware, static-first security auditor. Recon builds a schema-v2 inventory, focused worker waves apply layered checklists, and findings are deterministically deduplicated into a split report. Fan-out runs as external codex exec processes; the portable engine is bundled under the plugin's core/.
defaultPrompt: Run a whole-project security audit with fr-security-review.
Audit the changes in the current branch against the base branch.
